sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
The launch trailer gives Mu Xiaokui a new look and, more usefully for a player, a new fight shape: she arrives with her two attendants, which is a different problem from every other boss shown so far.

This is a pre-launch entry. Everything below comes from the launch trailer released 21-22 October 2026 and the coverage of it; nothing here is a claim about the shipping game's balance, and no strategy has been tested because no reviewer has had a final build long enough to publish one.

sections.title: Where To Find Mu Xiaokui With Yu Yao and Tie Gui
sections.content: Fight shown in the trailer; region not stated Coverage has not placed this fight on the map, and the game's regions are only partially named before release, so treat the location as unknown rather than implied.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
Nothing is confirmed. S-GAME has not published weakness data for any boss, and the trailer shows choreography rather than a stats sheet. What can be said is structural: she is not alone. Two attendants, Yu Yao and Tie Gui, fight alongside her, which makes this the only multi-target boss encounter shown before release. Her own threat in the footage is throws - grabs, which normally cannot be parried and which punish standing inside someone else's attack.

For the resource that governs this kind of read, see Sha-chi and the combat system - the guard-break mechanic is what makes heavy, committed attacks exploitable in general, which is the theory behind every one of these fights, not a verified answer for this one.

sections.title: What The Footage Actually Shows
sections.content:
• Fights with a fist-based stance, in a new form with her hair down
  • Yu Yao and Tie Gui intervene as a party of three
  • Throws described as landing hard on the protagonist
  • The only trailer boss shown as a group fight
  • No phase count or arena published

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: Unpublished. The general rule stated by S-GAME is that defeating powerful foes yields their weapons and signature techniques, so the expectation is a main weapon or Phantom Edge - but no drop has been attributed to this specific boss, and pre-launch drop tables on other sites are guesses.
